cases.name: capsule-three-identity-boundary
cases.intent: issuer, courier, and recipient execute as distinct OS identities
cases.expected_postcondition: all three UIDs are distinct and non-root

cases.name: capsule-agent-package-nondisclosure
cases.intent: agent inspects the complete signed capsule bytes
cases.expected_postcondition: no synthetic plaintext is recoverable from the package

cases.name: capsule-agent-private-key-denial
cases.intent: agent attempts to read the recipient-only HPKE private key
cases.expected_postcondition: kernel denies the untrusted agent UID

cases.name: capsule-agent-issuer-key-denial
cases.intent: agent attempts to read the issuer signing seed
cases.expected_postcondition: kernel denies the untrusted agent UID

cases.name: capsule-ciphertext-tamper-rejected
cases.expected_postcondition: signature or HPKE authentication fails before application write
cases.observed_postcondition: process failed: exit status 1 (error: invalid handoff capsule)

cases.name: capsule-wrong-destination-rejected
cases.intent: recipient receives a valid issuer capsule addressed to another logical destination
cases.expected_postcondition: no local registration matches the signed destination
cases.observed_postcondition: process failed: exit status 1 (capsule destination has no valid recipient-local trust registration)

cases.name: capsule-wrong-target-rejected
cases.intent: issuer-signed capsule names a target different from recipient registration
cases.observed_postcondition: process failed: exit status 1 (capsule rejected by recipient-local identity or issuer trust)

cases.name: capsule-expiry-rejected
cases.intent: recipient receives an already expired signed capsule
cases.observed_postcondition: process failed: exit status 1 (capsule rejected by recipient-local identity or issuer trust)

cases.name: capsule-agent-cannot-substitute-trust-flags
cases.intent: courier attempts to override recipient trust through import arguments
cases.expected_postcondition: recipient import accepts no trust or target flags
cases.observed_postcondition:
process failed: exit status 2 (flag provided but not defined: -issuer-key-id
Usage of recipient capsule import:)

cases.name: capsule-negative-controls-no-write
cases.intent: inspect application state after invalid capsules
cases.expected_postcondition: invalid packages made no application write

cases.name: capsule-concurrent-single-apply
cases.intent: two recipient processes import the same capsule concurrently
cases.expected_postcondition: journal claim permits at most one application write and both receive idempotent completion

cases.name: capsule-recipient-install-readback
cases.intent: inspect the recipient-owned OpenCode auth store
cases.expected_postcondition: only the registered recipient account contains the synthetic credential

cases.name: capsule-recipient-receipts
cases.expected_postcondition: both successful duplicate deliveries return receipts

residual_risks: real AegisKeys credential resolution, grant policy, and rotation not exercised
provider and recipient side effects are independently observed only in the full cross-broker qualification
recipient application identity beyond UID pinning not proven
